required_controls.name: Dependency version pinned
required_controls.why: Pinned versions improve reproducibility and reduce unexpected dependency drift.

required_controls.name: License documented
required_controls.why: License visibility helps avoid legal and compliance surprises.

required_controls.name: Package source trusted
required_controls.why: Dependencies should come from expected registries or controlled internal sources.

required_controls.name: Integrity hash recorded
required_controls.why: Hashes support artifact integrity verification and tamper detection.

required_controls.name: No known high-risk finding
required_controls.why: High-risk findings must be reviewed before release.
